body:
## Imagica Desktop v0.1.26

### Better pictures
- **Quality boost** (on by default): small models draw at their own size and get a detail pass, sturdier shapes, and sharper faces. Turn it off in the Studio for the model's raw picture.
- Fixed small models (SD 1.5) being asked for pictures far bigger than they can draw, which gave tiny, warped people.

### New in the Studio
- **Paste** (Ctrl+V) or **drag in** a picture to edit it.
- Under each picture: **Copy**, **Edit this**, **Again** (new seed), **Reuse settings**, **hold to compare**, **Undo edit**.
- **Quick edits**: Remove background, Fix faces, Make sharper, Make wider / taller.
- Make **1, 2 or 4 pictures** at once, see the **time left**, press **Esc** to stop, use **up/down** for earlier prompts, **?** for shortcuts.
- Your last size, quality, style and picture count are remembered.

### Fixes
- Updates now show up reliably, and the **Update** button on the workspace card works.
- Photo editor: Remove background and 4x Super resolution now really work.
- Clearer error messages that say what to do.

### Security
- The AI engine now only accepts requests from the Imagica app, so websites can't use it.
- Updates and helper models are checked before they are used.

> **Updating from v0.1.25 or older:** use **Settings -> Check now** (the card's Update button in those versions doesn't work).

---
> 🛡️ **Windows SmartScreen Note**:
> Because this is a fresh release build without an enterprise EV certificate, Windows SmartScreen may show *"Windows protected your PC"*.
> Simply click **"More info"** → **"Run anyway"** to launch the installer.
>
> 🍏 **macOS Gatekeeper Note**:
> The first time you open Imagica, macOS may say *"Apple could not verify Imagica Desktop is free of malware"*.
> Click **Done**, then open **System Settings** > **Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
> (On macOS 14 and older you can instead right-click the app and choose **Open**.) You only need to do this once.
>
> On an Intel Mac, image generation is not available: it needs a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer).
